description: This file defines the MemoryPoolSlab class, which manages a large memory block divided into smaller blocks for use in a byte buffer memory pool. It handles pinning the memory to prevent relocation, provides access to the native pointer, and manages disposal of resources.

classes.name: MemoryPoolSlab
classes.description: A class that manages a pinned memory slab used by a byte buffer memory pool, supporting creation, disposal, and status checking.

methods.name: MemoryPoolSlab
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the slab with a byte array and pins it in memory.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a new MemoryPoolSlab with a specified length.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the slab, unpinning the memory and releasing resources.
